meta.note: Retold: human soldiers, heroes and (since update 18.49472) buildings earn 1 favor per 80 damage; ships and Temple/Dock myth units 1 per 160; Odin's Great Hall units 1 per 64; Gatherers/Dwarves 1 per 20. Target multipliers: huntables x0.5, herdables/chickens x5, shooting buildings x0.5, walls x0, other buildings x0.1. After 100 total combat favor the gain rate falls linearly to x0.5 at 300 total (spent or not). Hersir/Godi also trickle 0.6/min each (unit trickle). Analyzer favor guide only confirms 'favor from combat, cap 200'. Favor cap: the game files (major_gods.xml, techtree.xml) define no favor cap; the wiki says favor has no cap since Retold; aomr-analyzer lists 100 (Greeks) / 200 (others) but the owner confirmed no cap for Greeks, so no favorCap is set (owner to verify in game).
